item.title: Pedestrian Critically Injured in Palm Desert Collision
item.description: A pedestrian is in critical condition following a vehicle collision Tuesday morning in Palm Desert.According to the Riverside County Sheriff’s Department, deputies responded around 9:45 a.m. to reports of a crash at the intersection of El Paseo and Ocotillo Drive. When they arrived, they found a pedestrian suffering from major injuries. The person’s identity has not been released.The pedestrian was transported to a nearby hospital for treatment. item.title: Three Displaced After Structure Fire Engulfs Home in Indio
item.description: Three people were displaced after a structure fire broke out Tuesday afternoon in Indio.According to fire officials, the fire started around 2:42 p.m. in the 82,200 block of Kenner Avenue. When crews arrived on scene, they found the home heavily engulfed in flames. item.title: New Federal Reserve Data Shows Americans More Pessimistic About Finances Despite Job Market Optimism
item.description: Americans may be feeling slightly better about the job market, but many say their personal finances are moving in the opposite direction.According to new data released by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, the share of Americans who say they are worse off financially than they were a year ago has reached its highest level in more than two years.The report points to growing concern about household finances, with more respondents expressing pessimism about the year ahead. item.title: Team USA Advances to Mixed Curling Gold Medal Match as Winter Olympics Competition Continues
